name: Crowdfunding Request Decision Notice
description: Written approval, denial, or conditional approval of a crowdfunding proposal, with the basis for any denial or limitation.
deadline: Within 10 days of receipt of the request
quote: The Superintendent or designee shall respond in writing to the individual(s) who submitted the crowdfunding request/proposal advising whether the request has been approved, denied, or approved subject to certain conditions within 10 days of receipt of such request/proposal.
